notes.title: Big Update! We're releasing out of Early Access
notes.notes:
Viking Chess: Hnefatafl releases out of Early Access this evening at approximately 19:00 CET!

Please join us this evening for online games. We are gathering a little crew of friends and developers to drink a few horns of mead and play the game with you!

We want to thank all players during Early Access, for your contribution to making Viking Chess a better game. As a homage to all players that helped out the development of this game, we have implemented an unlockable title in your honor; "Shaman". Win the title ingame by "finding the secret bug"!

Among the many fixes and improvements this update, you will find an exciting new feature, namely an unlockable Boardpiece Set. Once you win the set by completing the "Valkyrie" title, you unlock the epic "Valkyrie Set".

Since the 16th of October, and during these months of Early Access we have delivered many content updates and patches, improving the game bit by bit. And now, as we move out of Early Access, we are excited to see how the game develops further, hopefully with some more players coming to the game, and maybe a more active multiplayer scene. Personally, I am proud of this little game, and i am very glad for all the positive remarks and feedback on the game.

We look forward to your continued feedback, and we are aiming to improve the game further through content updates, also after this period of Early Access.

Thank you for your participation in this period of Early Access, and I hope you will enjoy the game for a long time.

All the best!
- Kenny G

notes.title: Update 0.15 - Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello Early Access players!

Patch notes:

- Added "Restart Game" button to Ingame menu in Singleplayer & Local Hotseat Multiplayer.
- Added "Concede Game" button to Ingame menu in Multiplayer(online). You can now concede a game, meaning that you admit defeat to your opponent and the game ends.
- Fixed default input keys for camera movement, that was set incorrectly last game update, and snuck itself into the update.
- Fixed an issue in Tutorial, where the new Input system did not work to move the camera.
- Fixed an issue in Tutorial, where "Exit to main menu" button did not work.
- Added functionality to let you choose a "Boardpiece package" to play with. These are the 3D models of pieces and associated assets. This feature is not completed yet, but you will see a dropdown menu in Singleplayer game setup where you can select a "Boardpiece set". Coming soon!
- Added unlockable title "Galning": As the Defenders, capture all Attackers

All the best!
- Kenny G

notes.title: Content Update 0.14 EA
notes.notes:
Hello Early Access players!

Here's a new content update with a host of new unlockable titles available for you to win, and some fixes and improvements!
Viking Chess: Hnefatafl releases out of Early Access soon! Tell your friends.

** Note ** 
- Your progression and unlocks will be wiped when the game leaves Early Access, but we'll give Early Access players an extra treat with an unique unlockable title that only players in Early Access will recieve -

New unlockable titles:
Note! Unlockable titles are not available to be unlocked in the Tutorial or in a local hotseat multiplayer game.
- "Raider": Win a game as the Attackers
- "Shield": Win a game as the Defenders
- "Bulwark": As the Defenders, win a game by constructing an Edge Fort
- "Kingslayer": As the Attackers, capture the King!
- "Invader": As the Attackers, end your turn with 4 Attackers around the Throne
- "Blood Axe": As the Attackers, capture all Defenders including the King
- "Suffocator": Play a Shieldwall attack
- "Jotun": Play a Multicapture attack

Fixes and improvements:
- For Multiplayer games that uses a round timer, the timer is now synced correctly over network.
- Added UI message ingame when an unlockable is unlocked.
- Moving the camera with middle mouse button is now smoother and better.
- Added a new input system. Next patch will include full gamepad support!
- Alot of general internal code optimization, for faster and easier development.

Upcoming features:
- A final AI update in Early Access
- Gamepad support
- Some more unlockable titles
- An exciting new feature. I hear the warcries of the Valkyries in the distance..

All the best!
- Kenny G

notes.title: Important issues and bugfix patch 0.12 EA
notes.notes:
Hello Early Access players!

We start the new year by resolving some important issues and bugs.

Thank you to community members that sent descriptive bug and issue reports on our Steam forum!

If you have an issue with the game or believe you've found a bug, please head on over to our Steam forum at our bug report forum or pop by our Discord.

Patch notes:

- Important: Resolved an issue where the King could be incorrectly captured in a Shieldwall. Note to players: The King cannot be captured in a Shieldwall in the Copenhagen ruleset of Hnefatafl.
- Important: Resolved an issue where an Edge Fort win condition would not be triggered correctly.
- Minor: Piece count in UI for each faction was not updated correctly when loading a game
- Minor: Reset button in UI was available to click when it was not supposed to be available.
- Minor: EditProfile UI window in Start Menu was enabled when leaving an active game returning to Start Menu.
- Minor: When viewing your Statistics in Edit Profile UI, the scroll speed of the scrollable view is now faster when using the mousewheel.

Going forward, we're developing faster now at the start of the new year. Viking Chess now have two developers working on the game, so we will try to release more frequent updates the coming weeks. We are aiming to release the game out of Early Access quite soon.

Upcoming content the next weeks:
- Improved visuals in some areas
- More unlockable prefix titles for your Player Profile
- Feedback when unlocking an unlockable
- Another AI improvement patch
- Steam Achievements


We're considering one last "heavy" feature for Viking Chess; A custom game editor, where you can setup a boardstate placing pieces on the board and setting up game parameters. Could be used for many things, like creating variants of Hnefatafl with different board sizes and number of pieces, strong/weak King rules, custom win conditions. You can either challenge the AI on a custom board or create a custom game lobby in Multiplayer. We want feedback from the community on this feature, please tell us in the comments or our Discord or our Steam Forum if this is a feature you would really, really like to see in the game.

As always, thank you for playing Viking Chess and leaving good reviews for our game!
Viking Chess currently has a positive rating on Steam, which is great!

All the best
- Kenny G

notes.title: Content Update v.0.11 EA
notes.notes:
Hello Early Access players!

Here's a present for the holiday season, a new content update with new features, also features requested by the community.

Note! MacOS players will recieve this update during the holiday

TL/DR patch notes:
- Local hotseat multiplayer. Now you can play on one machine against another human player!
- Game statistics. Check your number of wins, losses etc
- Unlockables. You can adorn your player name with a prefix title to show off your progression and skill to other players.
- Better AI on Hard and Nightmare difficulty. Easy and Medium will stay at their approximate difficulty level further on as well.

What we're working on next:
- Bugfix: Clicking "Reset" button on some tutorial levels does not work correctly.
- Bugfix: A situation was found where the king could be captured by 3 enemies around him.
- Bugfix: Check that Edge Fort mechanic is always triggered correctly.
- Bugfix: The king can capture a piece when the King lands on a corner tile and escapes.
- Issue: The timer on timed games in multiplayer does not synchronize correctly over all clients.
- Better feedback visuals, when winning a game for example or unlocking an unlockable
- Better AI for Hard and Nightmare difficulty.

Details:

Unlockable titles are found in "Player Profile" where you can click on an unlocked title and save to use the title.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/d0249dfd4f998ba99a07b97e23232c1f35c846ea.png

Game Statistics are found in your "Player Profile", accessed by clicking the button "My Statistics".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/f9e1f6e37a4b7fc9e9e45687fb40439190caf444.png

Local Hotseat Multiplayer is accessed in the Multiplayer Menu, clicking the button "Local Hotseat".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/028bdbe0e321ca7a6dff2fa7ba250cffb46d8451.png

Happy holidays, and all the best going into the new year!
- Kenny G

notes.title: Upcoming Content Patch 0.11EA
notes.notes:
Hello Early Access players!

Here's some news on an upcoming content update.

First off all, we apologize for some delay since the last update. 
We've had some stressfull weeks where we've done work on other projects to put food on our plates.
We're preparing a more meaty content update for you, that needs a little bit more time in the oven to cook just right.

Here's a few of the upcoming features in Content Patch 0.11 EA:

 Better AI. More finetuned behaviors, and in general a more difficult AI at higher difficulty levels.
 Bookkeeping. Recorded game statistics that you can view in your profile to keep track of your progress, like for example number of wins/losses and more cool stuff like number of captures you've made or number of special attacks like shieldwall you've made.
 Unlockables. You can unlock prefix titles to garnish your player profile name, and display your commitment and skill-level to your opponents. (Note! Progression *can* be wiped during Early Access and *will* be wiped when we come out of Early Access)
 A secret.... title for you to unlock, the "Highlander" title. Any guesses in the comments on how you can unlock it just based on the title reference? :)
 Setup for Steam Achievements.
 Bugfixes to bugs discovered by the community.
 Fix for Multiplayer games that use a turn timer, so that the timer is syncronized for both players.


The features listed take a little bit more time to implement than expected, but the content update will be coming soon(tm).

On another note; if you want to find other players to play Multiplayer games with, please use our Discord https://discord.gg/7HxACrx . We want to grow the community there over time, and hope that you players want to use the Discord server as a community hub.

Thank you all for playing our game, and giving valuable feedback to us in our Steam Community!

All the best
- Kenny G

notes.title: Patch notes v.0.09 EA - Content update, UI fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Early Access players, here's a new content patch for you!

Note! The patch is available on Windows now, Mac OS players will recieve the patch tomorrow 04.11.

Content:
- Singleplayer game setup in Start Menu have been reworked to be more in line with the rest of the game's UI.
- Players can now select difficulty levels when playing Singleplayer versus AI!
-- Difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Nightmare.
- Tweaks and updates to each AI difficulty level. Still a work in progress, but we're getting there!
- Overhauled many aspects of the user interface. 
-- Most importantly, all UI screens should now be displayed well on different resolutions.
-- Reworked many UI layouts.
-- Crisper and more readable text in UI.
-- Freshened up some sprite assets.
- New Viking Horn 3D model in all game scenes.
- Higher resolution of lightmaps in all game scenes.

As always, thanks for playing Viking Chess: Hnefatafl and thanks for your feedback so far!

notes.title: Patch 0.08 EA Patch notes
notes.notes:
Greetings all Early Access  players and thank you for playing our game and your feedback so far!

Much feedback have been gathered, both from our forums and other sources, and one thing that many players want is a better 2D camera view, viewing the board top down.
So we've created just that! :)

2D ortographic top down view:
--------------------------------------
- Accessed by pressing the button  in game, toggling between top down 2D mode and perspective 3D mode.
- New movepath graphics when in 2D view mode.
- Adjustments to 3D models when in 2D view mode, they no longer cast or recieve shadows to have a clearer visual read when viewing them top down in ortographic camera.
- Note! When you have selected an actor that you want to move; while the actor is selected you are not allowed to toggle between top down view mode and perspective. This is intentional.

Please hop over to the forums or our Discord at https://discord.gg/7HxACrx and tell us if you like the 2D feature or not! Thank you! :)

Tutorial mini-update:
------------------------------------
- When you do the tutorials for the "Edge Fort" mechanic or the "Defender Enclosure" mechanic, there are now a graphic in tutorial UI which tells you if you were successful or not.

Bug Fixes:
------------------------------------
- Fixed faulty triggers on Win Condition: Defenders are completely enclosed by attackers and no defender can reach the board edge. 

Upcoming Feature(s):
-----------------------------------
We are working on the progression and bookkeeping system. Soon you can garnish your profile name with unlockable prefix titles, and see your recorded game statistics. Note to all Early Access players! When we implement this feature in Early Access, expect the progression to be wiped after Early Access, so that new and old players start on the same playing field in terms of progression.

Have a good weekend, and GG to you all!

notes.title: Patch notes v.0.07
notes.notes:
We've had some busy days after launch in Early Access, with the "Konsoll" game developer conference in Bergen, Norway. Now we're back on it and ready to push out frequent updates.

Thank you all so far for feedback and reviews, we appreciate it!

Patch Notes version 0.07:

- The AI now selects a Move from a pool of "equally good moves", to encourage dynamic behavior.

- Fixed Win Condition where if a Faction have no available legal moves, that Faction looses the game.
